name.quote: "Department" means the department of inspections, appeals, and licensing.

type.quote: "Director" means the director of the department of inspections, appeals, and licensing.

required.quote: A contractor doing business in this state shall register with the director and shall meet all of the following requirements as a condition of registration

experience_source.quote: A contractor doing business in this state shall register with the director and shall meet all of the following requirements as a condition of registration

available.quote: Notwithstanding any other provision of law, an occupational or professional license, certificate, or registration, including a license, certificate, or registration issued by the board of educational examiners, shall be issued without an examination to a person if all of the following conditions are met

requirements.value: Must be currently licensed in another jurisdiction with substantially similar scope of practice, license in good standing, met minimum educational and experience requirements in issuing jurisdiction, passed required exams, no revocations or discipline, no pending complaints, pay applicable fees, no disqualifying criminal history.
requirements.quote: The person is currently licensed, certified, or registered by at least one other issuing jurisdiction in the occupation or profession applied for with a substantially similar scope of practice and the license, certificate, or registration is in good standing in all issuing jurisdictions

exists.quote: The director and inspectors of the department have jurisdiction for investigation and enforcement in cases where contractors may be in violation of the requirements of this chapter

regulatory_model.quote: A contractor doing business in this state shall register with the director

credential_type.quote: The director shall issue to each registered contractor an identifying public registration number and shall compile records showing the names and public registration numbers of all contractors registered in the state.

is_mandatory.quote: A contractor doing business in this state shall register with the director

title_protection.quote: A contractor doing business in this state shall register with the director and shall meet all of the following requirements as a condition of registration

scope_protection.quote: A contractor who is not registered with the director as required by this chapter shall not be awarded a contract to perform work for the state or an agency of the state.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: The requirement that a contractor be registered.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Contractor's registration information is not substantially complete and accurate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The requirement that the contractor's registration information be substantially complete and accurate.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Out-of-state contractor fails to file required bond with the department
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The requirement that an out-of-state contractor file a bond with the department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Contractor fails to maintain compliance with conditions necessary to obtain a registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The director shall revoke a registration number when the contractor fails to maintain compliance with the conditions necessary to obtain a registration.

bonding_required.quote: An out-of-state contractor shall either file a surety bond, as provided in section 91C.7, with the department in the amount of twenty-five thousand dollars

insurance_required.quote: The contractor shall be in compliance with the laws of this state relating to workers' compensation insurance and shall provide evidence of workers' compensation insurance coverage annually

definition_quote.value: "Contractor" means a person who engages in the business of construction, as the term "construction" is defined in the Iowa administrative code for purposes of chapter 96, the Iowa employment security law.
definition_quote.quote: "Contractor" means a person who engages in the business of construction, as the term "construction" is defined in the Iowa administrative code for purposes of chapter 96, the Iowa employment security law.

minimum_annual_revenue_threshold_usd.quote: a person who earns less than two thousand dollars annually or who performs work or has work performed on the person's own property is not a contractor for purposes of this chapter.

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Liability limitation clause (limiting contractor liability to cost of inspection report or contract price)
Indemnification / hold-harmless clause favoring the promisee's sole negligence
Waiver of consumer cancellation rights clause
Waiver of consumer rights (general statutory rights) clause
Blank spaces clause (material terms left blank for later completion)
Assignment of insurance proceeds clause (without owner consent / in violation of statutory requirements)
Clause authorizing unlawful entry or breach of peace for repossession
Lien disclosure notice omission (failure to include required lien disclosure)
Disclaimer or limitation of implied warranty clause
Clause entered into by unlicensed contractor (contract with unlicensed contractor)
Clause requiring compliance waiver from applicable building codes or zoning regulations
Distributed energy contract clause failing to meet statutory disclosure or terms requirements
